metadata.description: The Guava Stack for business owners and solo operators: a shared AI context hub (Notion, Google Drive or OneDrive/SharePoint), a planner + builder model router, and founder-mode.

plugins.name: guava-hub
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. Sets up a shared AI Context & Skills Hub in Notion, Google Drive or OneDrive/SharePoint, so all your AI assistants share your context, rules and skills. Part of the Guava Stack.

plugins.name: guava-router
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. Routes thinking work to a planner model and doing work to a builder model, through their CLIs or right in your Claude and ChatGPT apps, on the plans you already pay for. Works with Claude + ChatGPT, ChatGPT only or Claude only, and newer models swap in with a one-line change. Part of the Guava Stack.

plugins.name: founder-mode
plugins.description: For business owners and solo operators. 27 working rules so your AI assistant handles the safe work on its own and always checks with you before anything that could cost you money or can't be undone. Part of the Guava Stack.
